title: Bribe an NPC
body: Syntax: bribe <ryo amount> <npc name>\n\nOffer ryo to a non-player character with a bribe-triggered mob program. The ryo is deducted and the NPC may respond with dialogue, a quest action, or a conditional reward. Builders can use mpedit <vnum> bribe and if bribe($b) >= 500 to configure the response. NPCs without a matching bribe trigger refuse. See help mpedit for multiline scripting.
